action.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) AS actual FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'US01' AND period = '2026-03' AND CAST(account_id AS VARCHAR) = '6400' AND dept_id = 'MKT'), b AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS budget FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'US01' AND period = '2026-03' AND CAST(account_id AS VARCHAR) = '6400' AND dept_id = 'MKT') SELECT a.actual, b.budget, a.actual - b.budget AS variance FROM a, b
